public._comment: Public kind:1 read lane. Phase-0 safety gates: quarantine + bounds + rate limits.
public.staging_inbox: <channel name or UUID for pending posts; may EQUAL inbox for a single-channel lifecycle (pending and released together); omit => hold-and-log>
watch_authors: <hex pubkey of a trusted author whose kind:1 posts publish straight to the community channel>
watch_events: <event id of one of our own notes; replies to it are QUARANTINED unless the replier is an allowlisted author>
public.mirror_consent_hive_id: <64-hex Concord community_id; the stable hive identity consent binds to, NEVER a channel UUID>
public.mirror_consent_hive_name: <human-readable hive name, e.g. JA Fairweather's hive>
public.mirror_expected_tos_hash: <64-hex sha256 of the CURRENT ToS block; omit and it is derived from hive id+name+handle+terms_url, so a consent signed against superseded terms still binds. Set it explicitly and an older consent stops counting>
mirror_grandfathered: <pre-consent watched author hex, temporary explicit exception>
public.approver_mention: <Buzz @name mentioned in quarantine headers so arrivals notify the approver; omit for none>
public.owner_pubkey: <64-hex Nostr pubkey of the human who owns this hive; distinct from its bridge/agent identities>
approvers: <hex pubkey allowed to reply approve|watch|mute|reject on a quarantined post>
grantors: <hex pubkey whose signed NIP-DA 440/441 admit or revoke a granted participant; defaults to approvers>
scan_channels: <channel name or UUID of a WORKING channel to scan for @mentions/replies to a return-lane agent; NEVER the staging_inbox; omit => scan nothing>
relay_channels: <channel name or UUID an admitted agent may inject into by sealing a kind:14 request (relay tag = this channel) to waggle's OWN key; DEFAULT EMPTY, never implicitly inbox; an unlisted destination is dropped and the sender is acked ok:false; conveys no capability beyond the public lane except destination selection, which this allowlist gates>
scan_authors: <hex pubkey allowed to TRIGGER a return-lane carry (signer gate); omit => floors to approvers+grantors+trusted_repliers; bridge key is always excluded; live routing policy, held durable off-repo>

return_lane.npub_hex: <64-hex delivery key of an admitted agent — where its sealed mentions are addressed>
return_lane.protocol: <optional: nvoy-task-carry-v1 emits a typed carry containing the exact signed source event; requires Nvoy task + task-relay grants; omit for human-readable data-only carry>
authors: <64-hex Buzz-side key that signs THIS agent's own in-channel posts; drives echo-skip only while unique to one entry; omit if it shares the bridge key. Bind a key here ONLY if it signs exactly one agent's posts: the guard keys off config-entry count, not actual signing multiplicity, so pinning the de-facto-shared bridge key to a single entry silently defeats it (a cross-mention would be dropped as echo)>

policy_shadow.policy_instance: <stable hive policy id, required for observe/enforce-shadow>

policy_writer.policy_instance: <stable hive policy id, required for remote-only>
policy_writer.endpoint_authority: <exact Buzz API host bound into signed receipts>
